# ClearPath

> Free, open-source browser extension that makes any website accessible — simplifies text, reads pages aloud with word highlighting, and overlays AAC symbols. No account required.

ClearPath is built for AAC users, people with dyslexia, and anyone who needs web content on their own terms. It works on top of any existing website — no cooperation from the site owner required.

## Key facts

- Price: free, no account required, no data collected
- Platforms: Chrome and Firefox (Manifest V3 browser extension)
- License: open source, MIT
- Privacy: designed to work offline where possible; simplification can optionally use an LLM of your choice, or a fully offline rule-based mode

## Features

- **Read Aloud** — text-to-speech with word-by-word highlighting, built into every page. Configurable voice, speed, pitch. Works offline.
- **Simplify** — right-click any text and rewrite it in plain English at Grade 3, 5, or 8 reading level. Works with your choice of LLM, or fully offline with rule-based simplification.
- **Reading Mode** — strips pages down to their content, applies OpenDyslexic font, adjustable spacing, six color themes. Preference saved per site.
- **Symbol Overlay** — displays AAC pictogram symbols above words using the open ARASAAC library.
- **Focus Tools** — a reading ruler that follows the cursor, paragraph focus mode, word-complexity highlighting with simpler alternatives on hover.
